tools.name: generate_flashcard_deck
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a flashcard maker for supplied question-answer pairs: flip cards interactively, track review progress, print paired cut-out cards as an A4 or Letter PDF, or export an Anki-style Front/Back CSV. Removes identical pairs. Does not generate learning content, check facts, pro

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "generate_flashcard_deck" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
